purpose: Prove installed fleet readiness through the repository-owned PowerShell implementation so Windows policy that blocks a CMD compatibility shim cannot strand a healthy fleet.

steps.name: verify readiness authority
checks: pwsh resolves in the active Windows environment

steps.name: classify optional CMD shim
steps.action: If agent-switchboard.cmd was attempted and returned Access is denied or exit 5, record cmd-shim-blocked. Do not retry the shim, rerun setup, or downgrade fleet state solely for this boundary.

steps.name: invoke PowerShell readiness
steps.success: exit code 0 with current readiness output

steps.name: generate canonical readiness artifact
steps.rule: Resolve fresh artifacts through the tracked artifact registry; do not guess timestamped filenames.

steps.name: classify adapter state
rules: adapter-ready may continue to target-repository gates
Hermes blocked alone may remain TBD/deferred
blocked requested non-optional adapter stops that agent route

steps.name: handoff
steps.action: Report PowerShell launcher path, optional CMD shim state, -ListAgents exit, readiness artifact path/status, adapter classification, proof ceiling, and one exact next command.

proofCeiling: Proves local installed PowerShell launcher execution and current adapter readiness on the observed workstation. It does not prove provider authentication, exact model availability, quota, hosted response, repository delivery, merge, or deployment.
